title: Honor roll
statementMd:
List students who have at least three graded enrollments and an average of at least 85. Show name, count and average rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `name`, `graded`, `avg_score`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT s.name, COUNT(e.score) AS graded, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 1) AS avg_score FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name HAVING COUNT(e.score) >= 3 AND AVG(e.score) >= 85;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
